summary: Iteration 21 retest of the iteration_20 findings. BACKEND: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_spectator_label_scoping.py (2 tests) + re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_spectator_link_reactions.py (7 tests) -> 9/9 PASS in 23s. Verified POST /api/codes/spectator-link now filters reuse by label='Spectator': a view-only code minted via the form with label 'TEST_Alice' is NOT returned; a separate label='Spectator', view_only=true, granted_seconds=0 code is issued, no mongo _id leak, idempotent on repeat call, and both codes persist correctly in GET /api/codes with their own labels. Reaction relay, rate limit, emoji whitelist, owner->guest author='Owner' and view-only spectator WS accept all still pass. FRONTEND (Playwright, 2 contexts, clipboard perms): (1) REGRESSION FIX CONFIRMED — guest sent 🔥, waited 3.5s until zero floating-reaction-<id> in DOM on both admin and guest, then 💦, then 😩: each send rendered EXACTLY ONE floating emoji on BOTH admin and guest overlays with the correct emoji; no dismissed emoji reappeared at any point (previously 1->2->3). (2) NEW owner ReactionBar on /admin works: reaction-bar renders under obs-stream-with-reactions, clicking reaction-btn-🔥 produced one floating emoji on admin AND on the guest page, with the guest's .reaction-author label reading exactly 'OWNER'; a second owner reaction (💦) after fade-out rendered only the new emoji. (3) SHARE SPECTATOR LINK writes <public_url>/c/ZYYM2N to the clipboard, the card in ISSUED CODES shows label 'Spectator' + VIEW ONLY + 'Spectator link — no timer', and the code differs from the Alice code (5UBMMB). Both previously reported bugs are fixed; no new bugs found.

minor.issue: Reuse query is still not owner-scoped (matches any non-revoked view_only code with label=='Spectator'); harmless in this single-owner app but will collide in multi-owner setups. Also, if the owner manually creates a view-only code and names it exactly 'Spectator', the button will adopt it.
Carried over from iteration_20: chat_last_sent / 'react:<cid>' buckets are never pruned for disconnected clients (slow unbounded growth).

integration_issues.issue: Carried over (expected product behaviour): clipboard URL uses the admin-configured public_url (https://tg30.ddns.net/c/<CODE>), not the current origin, so the copied link cannot be opened from the preview host. Guest verification was done on the preview origin instead.

issues: Cosmetic only: ISSUED CODES now holds 33 entries (leftover test/spectator codes from prior iterations) which makes the list long; consider a filter/archive. Reaction bar spacing/contrast under the OBS card looks correct and the overlay stays pointer-events:none.

critical_code_review_comments: FloatingReactions seenRef Set grows for the lifetime of the page (one uuid per reaction). Fine for a session, but on a multi-hour stream with heavy reactions it is unbounded memory; consider capping/pruning (e.g. keep last 500 ids).

ReactionBar still uses a single shared 400ms lastRef across all emojis, so tapping two different emojis within 400ms silently drops the second with no user feedback (matches server bucket, but no UI hint).

AdminDashboard sendReaction is a no-op when the host WS is not open (sendHostMessage silently returns); the bar is disabled via disabled={!ble.wsConnected}, which is correct, but a tooltip would help.
seed_data_creation: Created view-only code label TEST_Alice21/TEST_Alice21b via the admin form; TEST_Alice21b deleted via DELETE /api/codes/{id} (200). TEST_Alice21 from the aborted first run and the reusable Spectator code ZYYM2N remain in the codes list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testids: login-email/login-password/login-submit. Admin owner ReactionBar lives inside the card under [data-testid='obs-stream-with-reactions']; guest bar is the same component. Floating emojis unmount ~2.4-3s after appearing, so always wait 3.5s before asserting resurrection. Copied spectator URL points at public_url (tg30.ddns.net) — always open guest pages on the preview origin. Leftover codes to clean: TEST_Alice21 (view-only).
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_20 resurrect bug is resolved: FloatingReactions now dedupes against a useRef(new Set()) of ever-seen ids instead of the `visible` state, so an id removed by onAnimationEnd can never be re-mounted when the parent's capped reactions array changes identity. Verified empirically (3 sequential sends, each after full fade-out, always exactly 1 element) on both admin and guest.
